guide.greenlantern.title: Corps Manual
guide.greenlantern.welcome.title: Welcome
guide.greenlantern.welcome:
You have been chosen! This manual teaches everything a new Green Lantern needs to know.

§aFirst steps§r
1. Craft a §2Power Ring§r (diamond + emeralds).
2. Craft a §2Power Battery§r and place it.
3. Click the battery with the ring in hand to charge it: a new ring comes empty.
4. Right-click with the ring (or press §eG§r) to put on the uniform.
5. Double-tap jump to fly and hold §eR§r to pick a construct.

Use the chapters on the left, the ◀ ▶ arrows below or the mouse wheel to navigate. Recipes are in the Recipes chapter.
guide.greenlantern.ring.title: Power Ring
guide.greenlantern.ring:
The ring is the source of all your powers: the uniform, flight and hard-light constructs.

§aEnergy§r
The ring stores up to 5000 energy. The bar shows on the item, in its tooltip and on the HUD in the top-left corner. Every construct costs energy to create, and some drain a little per second while they exist. Flying drains energy too, and the faster you fly, the more it costs.

When energy is low the HUD blinks red. With no energy left the uniform fades and constructs vanish.

§aUse§r
Without the uniform, right-click puts it on. With the uniform, right-click uses the selected construct.

The ring doesn't burn in lava or fire.
guide.greenlantern.battery.title: Power Battery
guide.greenlantern.battery:
The Power Battery is the lantern that recharges your ring.

§aCharging§r
Place the battery, hold the ring and right-click it. Energy flows from the lantern into the ring while you stay close, and the Corps oath appears on screen. Click again to stop.

You hear a chime when the ring is full. If you walk too far away, charging stops.

Take a battery on your travels: it can be mined with a pickaxe and placed again anywhere.
guide.greenlantern.uniform.title: Uniform
guide.greenlantern.uniform:
With the ring in hand, right-click or press §eG§r to put on the Corps uniform: hard-light mask, suit, leggings and boots.

§aProtection§r
The uniform protects like diamond armor. You need it to fly and to use constructs.

§aYour armor is kept safe§r
When you put the uniform on, the armor you were wearing is stored. Press §eG§r again to remove the uniform and you get it back.

Uniform pieces can't be taken off in the inventory or dropped.
guide.greenlantern.flight.title: Power flight
guide.greenlantern.flight:
With the uniform on, §edouble-tap jump§r to take off (or stop flying). Near the ground, take-off releases a burst of energy.

§aSpeed§r
Hold §eW§r and your speed keeps growing. With §eCtrl§r (sprint) it grows faster. After a few seconds you break the §asound barrier§r: sonic boom, vapor rings and "SUPERSONIC" on the HUD. You fly where you look.

§aManeuvers§r
• Double-tap §eA§r or §eD§r at high speed: barrel roll.
• Hold §eS§r at high speed: air brake.
• Dive into the ground fast: hero landing, a shockwave that throws nearby creatures (you take no damage).

Hitting a wall head-on at speed kills your momentum. The ring protects you from fall damage.
guide.greenlantern.constructs.title: Constructs
guide.greenlantern.constructs:
Constructs are hard-light objects created by your willpower.

§aPicking one§r
Hold §eR§r to open the construct wheel: point with the mouse and release (or click). On the wheel, keys §e1-8§r and the mouse wheel work too. A quick tap on §eR§r picks the next one, and §eShift + mouse wheel§r with the ring in hand also switches.

§a1. Energy Blast§r: click to launch a sphere that explodes on impact without breaking blocks.

§a2. Minigun§r: hold right-click for a continuous burst.

§a3. Protection Bubble§r: click to toggle. Absorbs most damage, pushes creatures away and reflects projectiles. Drains energy per second.

§a4. Giant Saw§r: a vehicle with a circular saw in front. Shreds creatures and cuts trees, leaves and plants. §eW/S§r drive, §eA/D§r strafe, the mouse steers, jump hops and sneak gets off.

§a5. Giant Hammer§r: a hammer appears where you look and slams the ground with a shockwave.

§a6. Giant Drill§r: a vehicle that bores and mines. See its chapter.

§a7. Giant Mecha§r: a 10 block suit of armour that walks, flies and fires lasers and missiles. See its chapter.

§a8. Portal to Oa§r: opens a portal to the planet Oa, home of the Corps. See the Oa and the Portal chapter.
guide.greenlantern.drill.title: Giant Drill
guide.greenlantern.drill:
The Giant Drill is a digging vehicle: you sit in a cockpit on tracks with a huge drill bit in front.

§aUsing it§r
Select the drill (construct 6) and right-click to summon it and climb in. Click again or sneak to get off.

§aDriving§r
• §eW§r moves where the bit points. The bit follows your aim.
• Looking ahead you drive and bore straight tunnels with a flat floor.
• Look down to dig shafts and up to bore through the ceiling.
• §eS§r reverses, §eA/D§r strafe, jump hops.
• Against rock the drill grips the walls, so you can stop halfway down a shaft. In open air it falls.

§aMining§r
The drill bores a tunnel big enough for itself and its rider and mines stone, dirt, sand, gravel and every kind of ore, including deepslate and Nether ores. Hard blocks like obsidian take longer. Bedrock is never broken. Mined items go straight to your inventory (whatever doesn't fit drops at your feet), and ores drop experience.

§aWeapon§r
The spinning bit hurts and pushes creatures that touch it.

§aTip§r
The drill drains energy every second: charge the ring before a long expedition and bring a Power Battery.
guide.greenlantern.mecha.title: Giant Mecha
guide.greenlantern.mecha:
The Giant Mecha is a 10 block tall suit of hard-light armour. You pilot it from the cockpit in its chest.

§aUsing it§r
Select the mecha (construct 7) and right-click: it builds itself around you, from the feet up. It needs open space for a 10 block giant. §eSneak§r to climb out, and it fades away.

§aWalking§r
• §eW/S§r walk, §eA/D§r sidestep.
• The torso turns to where you look and the legs follow slowly: the mecha is heavy.
• §eCtrl§r makes it run.
• It strides over steps up to 2 blocks high and bursts through treetops.

§aFlying§r
• Hold §ejump§r: the back thrusters spool up and the mecha lifts off.
• In the air, §eW§r flies where you look (look down to descend) and §eCtrl§r fires the afterburner.
• Release jump to hover, slowly sinking.
• A hard landing sends out a shockwave that throws nearby creatures.

§aWeapons§r
• §eHold right-click§r: the fist cannons fire twin lasers at the point you aim at. They hurt and set things on fire.
• §eLeft-click§r: a salvo of homing missiles leaves the shoulder pods and chases the creature you aim at (or the nearest enemy ahead). Reloads in 2 seconds.

§aProtection§r
Inside the cockpit you take no damage: the mecha absorbs hits, arrows and explosions with ring energy. You can't drown or burn either.

§aEnergy§r
The mecha drains energy every second, more while flying and firing the laser, and every missile salvo has a cost. If the ring runs dry, the mecha fades away.
guide.greenlantern.controls.title: Controls
guide.greenlantern.controls:
Keys can be changed in §eOptions → Controls → Key Binds → DC Universe§r.

§eRight-click§r (ring): put on the uniform or use the construct.
§eG§r: put on / remove the uniform.
§eR§r (hold): construct wheel.
§eR§r (tap): next construct.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (ring in hand): switch construct.
§eDouble-tap jump§r: take off / stop flying.
§eW§r while flying: accelerate. §eCtrl§r: accelerate faster.
§eA A§r or §eD D§r flying fast: barrel roll.
§eS§r flying fast: air brake.
§eW A S D§r in vehicles: drive. §eJump§r: hop. §eSneak§r: get off.
§eIn the mecha§r: §eW A S D§r walk, §eJump§r (hold) fly, §eCtrl§r run / afterburner, §eRight-click§r (hold) laser, §eLeft-click§r missiles, §eSneak§r get out.
§eRight-click the Battery§r: charge the ring.

§6The Flash§r
§eSprint§r (suit on): start running.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power wheel / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (Flash ring in hand): switch power.

§6Aquaman§r
§eIn the water§r (suit on): go where you look; §ejump§r rises, §esneak§r dives, §esprint§r builds up speed.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power wheel / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eRight-click§r (hold, release) with the trident: throw it.
§eOn the shark§r: §eLeft-click§r bite, §eSneak§r climb off.

§6Batman§r
§eJump§r (hold, while falling): glide with the cape; look down to dive and up to climb.
§eR§r (hold / tap): gadget menu / next gadget.
§eV§r: uses the selected gadget. §eJump§r on the hook: let go of the cable.
§eIn the Batmobile§r: §eW A S D§r drive, §eCtrl§r boost, §eLeft-click§r missiles, §eSneak§r get out.
guide.greenlantern.recipes.title: Recipes
guide.greenlantern.recipe.power_ring: A diamond on top and four emeralds forming the band. The ring comes out empty: charge it at a Power Battery before using it.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.power_battery: Iron ingots in the corners, lime stained glass on the sides, a lantern in the middle and an emerald block below.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.guide_book: A book and an emerald, in any position. Craft another manual if you lose yours.
guide.greenlantern.tips.title: Tips
guide.greenlantern.tips:
• In Creative mode, the §2DC Universe Heroes§r tab has rings that are already charged.

• Keep an eye on the energy bar. Vehicles (saw, drill and mecha) and the bubble drain energy all the time.

• Use the Giant Saw to gather wood and the Giant Drill to mine: both are great weapons too. To face a horde or a boss, call the Giant Mecha.

• The bubble reflects arrows and other projectiles.

• Supersonic flight costs up to 3 times more energy.

• Every number in the mod (energy, costs, damage, speeds, whether the drill mines or the saw cuts plants) can be tuned in §econfig/greenlantern-common.toml§r. Visual effects and the flight music are in §econfig/greenlantern-client.toml§r.

• Batman is at his best at night: the belt charges faster in the dark. Chain the hook into the cape: let go of the cable up high with jump and keep holding it to glide away.

"In brightest day, in blackest night, no evil shall escape my sight!"

guide.greenlantern.oa.title: Oa and the Portal
guide.greenlantern.oa:
Oa is the home planet of the Green Lantern Corps, at the center of the universe. You get there with the Portal construct.

§aOpening the portal§r
Select the Portal (construct 8) and right-click: an oval of hard light opens three blocks in front of you. Walk through it to travel to Oa. The portal stays open for 20 seconds, so your friends can follow.

§aComing back§r
On Oa, use the Portal construct again: it opens the way back to exactly where you left.

§aThe city§r
• You arrive on a dais at the edge of the great plaza.
• In the middle stands the §2Central Power Battery§r, a giant lantern that shines a green beam into the sky. Stand near it and your ring recharges by itself.
• Around it, eight pillars hold the §bGuardians of the Universe§r. Fly up and right-click one to hear their wisdom: they also refill your ring.
• Lanterns of many species walk around the plaza and patrol the sky. Right-click them to chat.
• Spires of dark stone and quartz rise around the plaza, with rings of green light and crystals on the plains.

§aGood to know§r
• Oa has eternal night under a green starry sky and its own music.
• No monsters spawn on Oa, and you can't sleep there.
• The portal costs ring energy (portalCost in the config).

guide.greenlantern.flash.title: The Flash
guide.greenlantern.flash:
The DC Universe keeps growing: the first new hero is §cthe Flash§r, the fastest man alive.

§6The ring§r
Craft the §6Flash Ring§r (redstone, gold and a lightning rod). Like Barry Allen's, it stores the suit: right-click or press §eG§r to put it on (cowl, suit, leggings and boots). One hero at a time: putting on the Flash suit removes the Lantern uniform and vice versa.

§6Super speed§r
With the suit, §esprint§r to start running. Keep holding §eforward§r and the speed keeps building up: it breaks the sound barrier (with a boom) after a few seconds and keeps going. Hold §eback§r to skid to a stop and §esneak§r to slow down.

§6On water and up walls§r
Fast enough, you run over water. Run into a wall and you go straight up it: §ejump§r to kick off the wall, keep going to vault over the top.

§6Super jump§r
Jump while running: the faster you are, the higher and farther you go. Speedsters take no fall damage.

§6Speed Force§r
The powers use Speed Force (yellow bar). It recharges slowly while you wear the suit, and much faster while you run.
guide.greenlantern.flash_powers.title: Flash Powers
guide.greenlantern.flash_powers:
With the Flash suit, hold §eR§r for the power wheel (tap R for the next power) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the ring) to use the selected power.

§6Tornado§r
The Flash runs in circles and the air becomes a vortex: creatures around are pulled in, lifted, spun and hurt, and thrown out when it ends. While it lasts you run around it on your own; sneak or use the power again to stop. Costs Speed Force every second.

§6Molecular Vibration§r
Pass through walls, floors and attacks. You do not fall: hold §ejump§r to rise and §esneak§r to sink. It ends when you use it again, after 10 seconds or when the Speed Force runs out, and you are always pushed out to the nearest free spot: no suffocating in walls or falling through the world.

§6Speed Force Lightning§r
Throw a bolt of lightning that arcs to up to two more enemies nearby. Throw it while running fast and it hits much harder.

guide.greenlantern.aquaman.title: Aquaman
guide.greenlantern.aquaman:
The next hero of the DC Universe is §bAquaman§r, the King of Atlantis.

§6The emblem§r
Craft the §6Atlantean Emblem§r (prismarine shards, gold and a nautilus shell). Right-click or press §eG§r to put on the suit: the orange scale shirt, the green leggings and the boots (your helmet stays). One hero at a time: putting on one suit removes the others.

§6Son of the sea§r
With the suit you breathe underwater and see clearly in the deep. You are tougher, hit harder, mine fast underwater and ordinary falls don't hurt you.

§6Swimming§r
In the water you go where you look, as if flying: §eW A S D§r move, §ejump§r rises and §esneak§r dives. Hold §esprint§r and the speed keeps building up to a speed no fish can match, leaving a sea-green trail with spiralling bubbles. Race up through the surface and you leap out of the water like a dolphin.

§6Power of the Seas§r
The powers use the Power of the Seas (the wave bar). It refills quickly in the water, at half the rate in the rain and slowly on dry land.
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_powers.title: Sea Powers
guide.greenlantern.aquaman_powers:
With the suit, hold §eR§r for the power wheel (tap R for the next power) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the emblem) to use the selected power.

§6Trident of Atlantis§r
The trident appears in your hand. It hits much harder than a diamond sword, knocks enemies back and splashes the ones around. Hold §eright-click§r and release to throw it: it flies straight, hits hard (harder in water and rain) and always comes back to your hand. Use the power again to call it back or send it away.

§6Great White Shark§r
In the water, a great white shark comes from the deep and you ride it. It swims where you look: §eW§r speeds up, §esprint§r is a burst, §ejump§r rises. §eLeft-click§r: it bites what is in front of its jaws. §eSneak§r to climb off: it stays around you hunting monsters; right-click it to climb back on. Use the power again to send it away.

§6Call of the Sea§r
The sea creatures around (fish, squids, dolphins, turtles, axolotls...) follow you and attack the monsters near you and whoever hurts you, for 30 seconds. If too few answer, dolphins come from the deep. Use it again to release them.

§6Portal to Atlantis§r
A whirlpool opens in front of you and leads to Atlantis, at the bottom of the ocean. Inside Atlantis, the same power opens the way back to the exact spot you came from (see the Atlantis chapter).

§6Kraken§r
A 15 block tall Kraken rises from the deep and you ride on its head, on land and in the sea. Left click slams a tentacle, holding right click fires a water jet. It has its own life (see the Kraken chapter).
guide.greenlantern.kraken.title: The Kraken
guide.greenlantern.kraken:
The fifth power of the sea. Pick §6Kraken§r on the power wheel and press §eV§r: a 15 block tall Kraken rises from the deep (or out of the ground) right under you, and you ride on top of its head. It costs 400 Power of the Seas and needs open space around you.

§6Moving§r
On land it walks on its eight arms: slow and heavy, every step shakes the ground. §eW§r walks, §esprint§r is a heavy charge, §ejump§r is a leap that lands with a shockwave. It climbs two block steps and bursts through leaves.
In deep water it stretches out like a squid and races where you look: §eW§r speeds up, §esprint§r is a burst, §ejump§r rises. It can reach the surface but never leaves the water by swimming.

§6Attacks§r
§eLeft click§r: one of its two hunting tentacles rises over its head and slams down about nine blocks in front of it, crushing and throwing back everything around the blow (hold it to keep slamming).
§eHold right click§r: a powerful jet of water from its siphon, where you aim. It batters and pushes away everything along the stream and puts out fires. It drains 10 Power of the Seas per second.

§6Its own life§r
The Kraken has 400 life (see the bar under your powers). Monsters, arrows and explosions aimed at you hit the Kraken instead. In the water its wounds slowly heal. If its life runs out it dies, you fall off, and it needs 60 seconds to recover before it can be called again.

§6Off its head§r
§eSneak§r to climb off: it stays and fights the monsters around you on its own. Right click it to climb back on. Use the power again to call it back to you or, while riding, to send it back to the deep.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.aquaman_emblem: Prismarine shards in the corners, gold ingots on the sides and a nautilus shell in the center. The emblem starts without Power of the Seas: put on the suit and swim to fill it.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.0: Welcome to Atlantis, surface traveller. Take a deep breath... ah, right, you can't.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.1: The palace beacon shines all the way to the surface. That's how our children find their way home.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.2: The coral gardens have been tended for a thousand years. Please mind the anemones.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.3: The King spoke to the sharks this morning. They promised to behave.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.4: No gills? There's a respirator in the Pavilion of Portals for visitors from the surface.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.5: The bubble columns in the gardens rise all the way to the sky. The children love racing up them.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.6: They say the throne's treasure keeps the emblem of the kings of Atlantis.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.7: Ever seen a Green Lantern down here? Their green light scares the lanternfish.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.8: Surface dwellers throw too much into the sea. We keep the pretty shells.
entity.greenlantern.atlantean.say.9: The copper towers turned green before we even sank. They match the kelp.
By the crown of Atlantis! No monster gets past our gates.
Move along, visitor. The royal guard is on patrol.
The King trusts his trident. We trust ours.
Drowned prowl the kelp slopes at night. Stay close to the light.
The palace is open to the people, but the throne's chests belong to the King.
You swim well, for a surface dweller.
power.greenlantern.atlantis_portal.desc: Opens a whirlpool that leads to Atlantis, at the bottom of the ocean. Opened in Atlantis, it takes you back to the exact spot you came from.

guide.greenlantern.atlantis.title: Atlantis
guide.greenlantern.atlantis:
§bAtlantis§r, the sunken kingdom, is not another dimension: it lies at the bottom of a deep ocean of this very world, in a crater far below the sea floor, some way from spawn. Every world has its own, and it builds itself in the first seconds of play.

§6The city§r
The Royal Palace, a pyramid of dark prismarine and gold with the throne hall, and a beacon on top whose cyan beam rises out of the sea (that's how you find it when sailing). Two colossal statues of the King guard the entrance. Marble avenues with columns of light, eight towers with copper domes, glass-domed houses, coral gardens with bubble columns, the wall with four gates and slopes covered in kelp forests. Tropical fish, dolphins, turtles and glow squid swim everywhere.

§6The Atlanteans§r
Citizens swim between the houses and gardens; right-click to talk. The Royal Guard patrols the palace and the wall with tridents and drives off monsters. Look for the chests of the throne, the armory and the houses.

§6Getting there§r
§bAquaman§r has the §6Portal to Atlantis§r power (power wheel). Other heroes use the §6Atlantis Gate§r: right-click opens the same portal. You arrive in the §6Pavilion of Portals§r, a glass dome full of air with a copper door to the city. Open the portal again inside Atlantis and it takes you back to the exact spot you came from.

§6Atlantean Respirator§r
Hero suits can't be taken off and their masks hold the helmet slot, so the respirator is not armor: it works from anywhere in the inventory, like a totem, and clips on over the mask or helmet. Underwater it breathes for you (its air bar shows above the hunger bar) and holds 8 minutes of air, which refills quickly out of the water. Aquaman doesn't need it. The first visitor finds one in the pavilion's chest.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.atlantis_gate: Gold ingots in the corners, prismarine crystals on the sides, a heart of the sea in the center and an ender pearl below. There is also one in the palace treasure.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.atlantean_resp: Prismarine shards, a gold ingot on top, kelp on both sides and a glass bottle in the center (the air tank).
power.greenlantern.kraken.desc: A 15 block tall Kraken rises from the deep and carries you on its head, on land (slow and heavy) and in the sea (fast). Left click: tentacle slam. Hold right click: water jet. It has its own life: it takes the blows aimed at you. Use the power again to send it away.

power.greenlantern.batarang.desc: Throws a batarang where you aim. It cuts, slows the target for a moment, bounces off walls and comes back to the belt. Up to three in the air at once.
power.greenlantern.grapple.desc: Fires the hook up to 48 blocks. Once it bites into a block, the cable reels you in (high or far) and flings you over the ledge. Jump lets go mid-way. Hit a creature and it is pulled to you.
power.greenlantern.bat_swarm.desc: Calls a cloud of bats that circle you for 25 seconds, attack and blind your enemies and stop arrows and other projectiles. Use again to scatter them.
power.greenlantern.batmobile.desc: The Batmobile pulls up and you get in. W accelerates, S brakes and reverses, A and D steer, jump hops. Ctrl fires the jet boost, left-click launches missiles. Use again to get out and send the car away.

guide.greenlantern.batman.title: Batman
guide.greenlantern.batman:
The next hero of the DC Universe is §7Batman§r, the Dark Knight. He has no superpowers: he has training, an armored suit and a belt full of gadgets.

§6The belt§r
Craft the §6Utility Belt§r (leather, gold, iron and a phantom membrane). Right-click or press §eG§r to put on the suit: the cowl with its ears and night vision, the gray suit with the bat on the chest, the leggings and boots, and the long black cape. One hero at a time: putting on a suit takes the others off.

§6The Dark Knight§r
In the suit you are tougher, hit harder, move a little faster and see in the dark. Falls hurt much less.

§6Gliding with the cape§r
Falling from a height (more than two blocks above the ground), §ehold jump§r: the cape spreads like a wing. Look down to dive and pick up speed, look up to trade speed for height (out of speed, you lose lift). Turn by looking around, §eS§r brakes. Let go of jump to fold the cape. While gliding you never take fall damage.

§6Belt Charge§r
The gadgets use the Belt Charge (the bar of yellow cells). It recharges on its own, faster in the dark.
guide.greenlantern.batman_powers.title: Batman's Gadgets
guide.greenlantern.batman_powers:
In the suit, hold §eR§r for the gadget menu (tap R for the next one) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the belt) to use it.

§6Batarang§r
Throws a batarang where you aim. It cuts, slows the target, bounces off walls and comes back. Up to three in the air.

§6Grappling Hook§r
Fires the hook up to 48 blocks. Once it bites into a block, the cable reels you in, faster and faster, and flings you over the ledge: perfect for climbing buildings and cliffs. §eJump§r lets go mid-way (you keep the momentum, great to chain into a glide); §esneak§r lets go too. Hit a creature and the hook pulls it to you.

§6Bat Swarm§r
A cloud of 16 bats circles you for 25 seconds. They attack the monsters near you and whoever hurts you, blinding and slowing them, and throw themselves in front of arrows and other projectiles. Use again to scatter them.

§6Batmobile§r
The Batmobile pulls up and you get in the cockpit. §eW§r accelerates, §eS§r brakes and reverses, §eA D§r steer, §ejump§r hops. Hold §eCtrl (sprint)§r for the jet boost (uses charge). §eLeft-click§r fires two missiles that seek the target in your sights. Crashing into enemies at speed runs them over, and inside the car you take much less damage. §eSneak§r gets out; use the power again to get back in or to send the car back to the Batcave. Left parked alone for 3 minutes, it drives off.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.utility_belt: Leather in the corners, gold ingots on top and bottom, iron ingots on the sides and a phantom membrane in the center. The belt starts empty: put on the suit and wait for the cells to charge.
